headline: Huawei Launches First PC Built Entirely With Domestic Components
summary: Huawei Technologies unveiled its Qinyun HM650 enterprise desktop, powered by its proprietary Kirin X90 processor and HarmonyOS, avoiding components from US chipmakers.
why: Huawei is leading China's technological self-reliance push, reducing dependence on US semiconductor and software suppliers amid export restrictions.

impacts.name: Huawei Technologies Co., Ltd.
impacts.why: Demonstrates successful product commercialization without Western hardware or software inputs.
